name: popover
purpose: Non-modal dialog anchored to a trigger button (APG disclosure plus non-modal dialog). Renders in the top layer through the Popover API, positioned next to the trigger, with Escape, outside-pointer, and focus-out light dismiss arbitrated by the shared overlay stack.
whenToUse: Contextual content or controls tied to a trigger: filters, quick settings, details, a small form.
Content the user may interact with (links, buttons, inputs) that should not block the rest of the page.
whenNotToUse: Tasks that must be completed or dismissed before continuing: use Dialog.
Short, non-interactive hints on hover or focus: use Tooltip.
A list of commands or choices: use Menu or Select.
Essential content users must not miss: keep it inline on the page.
responsive: Content width up to min(24rem, 100vw - 2rem); the block size is capped at the available space on the chosen side and the popup scrolls. The positioning engine flips and shifts to stay in the viewport.
rtl: `start`/`end` placements are logical: in RTL, bottom-start aligns the popup to the trigger's right edge. Header and close button use logical properties.
theme: Surface, border, radius, and shadow tokens. Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText border.
security: Title, label, and string content are rendered as text; never parsed as HTML. Node content is inserted as given (the consumer owns it). CSP-safe: positioning uses the CSSOM.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: One popover open at a time, nested inside a Dialog; many closed instances per page (listeners only on the trigger and popup).

limitations: The trigger should be a native <button>: Enter and Space activation relies on the native click. Other elements need their own keyboard activation.
The popup is inserted immediately after the trigger, so it inherits the trigger's container styles such as `dir` and font; it is not portaled.
The heading is always an h2.
Close animation is not played; the open fade uses @starting-style and is removed under reduced motion or `animation: 'none'`.
Canceling aui-cancel for a focus-out close leaves the popup open while focus is elsewhere.
unsupported: Modal behavior (inert background, focus trap): use Dialog.
Rendering HTML strings as content (pass a Node instead).
antiPatterns: Popovers without an accessible name (the component throws).
Putting essential, non-recoverable input in a popover that light-dismisses; listen to aui-cancel or use a Dialog.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/popover: AuiPopover directive ([auiPopover]) on the trigger; [auiPopover] binds a TemplateRef rendered as the content.
